#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

long long p, k;
const int MOD = 1000000007;

long long pow_mod(long long a, long long b)
{
    long long ret = 1;
    while (b)
    {
        if (b & 1) ret = ret * a % MOD;
        b >>= 1;
        a = a * a % MOD;
    }
    return ret;
}

int main()
{
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    cin >> p >> k;
    if (k == 1)
    {
        cout << pow_mod(p, p) << endl;
        return 0;
    }

    vector<long long> nxt(p, 0);
    for (long long i = 1; i < p; ++i)
        nxt[i] = (k * i) % p;

    vector<char> vis(p, 0);
    int cnt = 0;

    for (long long i = 1; i < p; ++i)
    {
        if (vis[i]) continue;
        long long t = i;
        while (!vis[t])
        {
            vis[t] = 1;
            t = nxt[t];
        }
        ++cnt;
    }

    cout << pow_mod(p, cnt) << endl;
    return 0;
}
